Probably a one-person operation with a lot of orders to fulfill, but I can't give a 5 star rating for shipping. Everything else was great. Would buy from this seller again but know that your package might take a few weeks to arrive.

The packaging was good, but the item's box was slightly dented from shipoing in a vinyl bubble mailer and not a box. There was limited communication from the seller. The item is as described and a good value for the going price currently.
